question: (frac{3)/(7)+1(2)/(3)times 6 - (3 (1)/(2)div (3)/(5) {of} (7)/(9)) {of} (2)/(3)}{(1)/(7) (4 div (1)/(5) {of} 10 )-3}
solution:
Given:

(frac{3)/(7)+1(2)/(3)times 6 - (3 (1)/(2)div (3)/(5) {of} (7)/(9)) {of} (2)/(3)}{(1)/(7) (4 div (1)/(5) {of} 10 )-3}

Concept used:

Calculation:- 

Let's first solve the numerator of the equation:-

⇒ (3)/(7) + (5)/(3) times 6 - ((7)/(2) div (3)/(5) of (7)/(9)) of (2)/(3) 

⇒ (3)/(7) + 10 - ((7)/(2) div (7)/(15)) of (2)/(3)

⇒ (3)/(7) + 10 - ((15)/(2)) of (2)/(3)

⇒ (3)/(7) + 10 -5

⇒ (3)/(7) + 5= (38)/(7)

Let's solve the denominator of the equation:-

(1)/(7) (4 div (1)/(5) {of} 10 )-3

⇒ (1)/(7) (4div 2) - 3 

⇒ (1)/(7)(2)-3= (2)/(7)-3=(-19)/(7)

Let's divide the numerator and the denominator we get:-

⇒ (38)/(7) div (-19)/(7) 

⇒ (38)/(7) times (7)/(-19) = -2

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3 i.e. -2**
